question: Is the available provider/client and upgrade evidence sufficient to accept the cross-provider compatibility and message-delivery behavior changes in this draft?
rationale: Focused tests provide strong regression evidence, but repository policy requires provider-native fidelity and the patch changes several observable contracts and recorder retry semantics at once.

options.title: Require representative provider proof
options.body: Keep the draft open until independent-client or authoritative protocol comparisons and recorder upgrade behavior are documented for representative changed contracts.

options.title: Accept test-backed risk
options.body: Approve the coordinated behavior changes based on the focused regression suite and explicit maintainer protocol review.

options.title: Split the review surface
options.body: Separate recorder durability from provider-specific protocol changes if maintainers cannot confidently validate the combined compatibility surface.

recommendation.title: Require representative provider proof
recommendation.body: Keep the draft open until independent-client or authoritative protocol comparisons and recorder upgrade behavior are documented for representative changed contracts.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member owns the coordinated commits and is the strongest available routing candidate for assembling the provider and recorder evidence.
